text:
sam.marketing: Quick thread ":wave:" - proposing a controlled 'prefetch gating' flow for inbound leads during big launches. objective: keep RR intact but reduce cold claims and SLA misses.

devon-sdr: curious - what does "prefetch gating" actually do in the claim path?

sam.marketing: on lead create we kick an async enrichment (non-blocking). if enrichment arrives within X ms we tag lead prefetched and claim logic prefers it for a short grace window; if not, RR proceeds unchanged. no weight changes.

pat-salesops: important to avoid making this a priority lane. prefer-only, never preempt. also need audit fields so reps know which info is temporary.

hs-sync-bot: mapping reminder: add HS props `prefetch_state` (none|pending|prefetched|failed), `prefetch_ts`, and `prefetch_source`. SF mapping will carry `prefetch_state`.

ari-ops: minimal canary config I'm thinking: feature flag `routing.prefetch_gate.v1`, canary 3%, enrich_wait_ms=2500, prefer_window_ms=30000, claim_lock_ms=40000.

noelle-growth: start cohort: leads where utm_campaign=launch_q3 OR form=demo_request. gives coverage without touching all inbound at once.

devon-sdr: will temp fields be overwritten by rep edits? last time we had bad merges.

sam.marketing: guardrails: prefetch writes to `temp_*` props. we only promote to canonical props if the enrichment score>0.8 OR rep explicitly promotes. no silent overwrites.

pat-salesops: add circuit-breaker: if RR fairness index worsens by >10% or p95 claim latency increases by >20% we auto-disable the flag.

ari-ops: here's a tiny sample JSON for the flag so ops can flip quickly:
```json
{"flag":"routing.prefetch_gate.v1","canary_pct":3,"enrich_wait_ms":2500,"prefer_window_ms":30000,"claim_lock_ms":40000}
```

noelle-growth: metrics to track: `prefetch_try_rate`, `prefetch_success_before_claim_pct`, `claims_prefetched_pct`, `rr_fairness_index`, `claim_latency_p95_ms`, and `manual_promote_rate`. we want a clear signal that reps are not confused.

devon-sdr: please add a tiny HUD tile in HS that shows "prefetch status" and a help link. that will cut noise.

sam.marketing: will draft a one-pager for SDRs: how to spot temp fields, how to promote, and when to leave a comment. also short internal slack notice.

hs-sync-bot: created feature flag `routing.prefetch_gate.v1` and HS props in staging. remember to update downstream SF mapping.

ari-ops: i'll deploy to staging and then roll the 3% canary at 7pm PT. monitor cadence: +5m, +30m, +2h. i'll post to #handoff-sla.

pat-salesops: quick runbook for ops: if `rr_fairness_index` >10% degrade, run `./scripts/feature-flag disable routing.prefetch_gate.v1` and alert #sales immediately.

noelle-growth: timeline: canary 24-48h, review SDR feedback and metrics, if stable widen to 20% then full. scheduled check-in Fri 9:30am PT. :rocket:

devon-sdr: thanks - appreciate the cautious rollout. will gather rep feedback and flag any weirdness.

sam.marketing: perfect. ops please post the exact HS prop names and a sample webhook payload in #handoff-sla so salesops can validate mappings.

hs-sync-bot: sample payload (staging): `{lead_id: 12345, prefetch_state: "prefetched", prefetch_ts: 4100009950, temp_company: "Acme Inc (temp)", prefetch_score: 0.92}`

ari-ops: pushing staging now. will update here after the +5m smoke.

sam.marketing: thanks team, quick and small. check-in Fri 9:30am PT.
